mapper.select: select id, user_id, destination_id, stars_earned, checkin_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from xl_user_checkin where user_id = #{userId} and destination_id = #{destinationId}
select count(*) from xl_user_checkin where destination_id = #{destinationId}

select c.id, c.user_id, c.destination_id, c.stars_earned, c.checkin_at, d.name as destination_name, d.region from xl_user_checkin c left join xl_destination d on d.id = c.destination_id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.checkin_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into xl_user_checkin (user_id, destination_id, stars_earned, checkin_at, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{destinationId}, #{starsEarned}, now(), now())
